# Copilot review loop report

Reviewed both unresolved Copilot comments on pull request 377 at immutable head
`ba1cdf0d96365a55af87e62c2f476245af685bbb`. Both findings were warranted and
fixed in the single-parent commit
`c9835cc139a49028e479a97efb9af34414c11775`.

- Pending-run retry records now enter the collection result as each retry
  succeeds, so a later rate-limit pause cannot discard already-checkpointed
  records. Regression coverage confirms the completed retry is returned and
  only the interrupted retry remains pending.
- First-run data-branch initialization no longer runs `git rm` after
  `git switch --orphan`.
